messages.author: 2ea9cb5e12a1a254
messages.subject: Control of Dimensions of Image?
parts:
I have a tree and matrix that I am using to display with gheatmap. That is working splendidly. However, I have labels for the columns that are much longer than I have used before and they will not fit using the advice previously given (https://github.com/GuangchuangYu/ggtree/issues/26). I would consider changing the labels to numbers or letters and including a key elsewhere, but that would be a very sub-optimal choice given the number of columns.

Is there any way to force the object out of ggtree or gheatmap to be "taller" than it defaults to to allow longer vertical column labels to fit?

P.S. - This package is great and it is really appreciated how responsive you have been to questions/requests.

messages.author: cec41188340e8212
messages.subject: Re: Control of Dimensions of Image?
parts: just use ylim, http://docs.ggplot2.org/current/lims.html, to allocate more space vertically.
